## `admin_users_list`

Class: read

List users in the Workspace customer. Filter by domain or customer=my_customer.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (must be a Workspace admin); "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `customer` | string | optional |  |
| `domain` | string | optional |  |
| `query` | string | optional | Directory search query: space-separated clauses of field+operator+value, ANDed together. "=" is exact match, ":" is a contains/startsWith match. Searchable fields include email, name (matches the concatenated givenName+familyName), givenName, familyName, isAdmin, isDelegatedAdmin, orgName, orgTitle, orgDepartment, manager, directManager, addressCountry. Prefix/wildcard matching is a trailing "*" on a ":" clause, e.g. "email:admin*" for every address starting with "admin". Examples: 'name:John', 'isAdmin=true', 'orgTitle:Manager orgName=Engineering'. |
| `maxResults` | number | optional |  |
| `pageToken` | string | optional |  |
| `orderBy` | enum | optional |  |
| `showDeleted` | boolean | optional |  |
| `projection` | enum | optional |  |

## `admin_users_update`

Class: update

Update a Workspace user (PATCH semantics). Can suspend a user or set a password, so it asks for confirmation like the Google API escape hatch (runs without asking only under full-writes).

|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (must be a Workspace admin) |
| `userKey` | string | required | User email or ID |
| `givenName` | string | optional |  |

| `changePasswordAtNextLogin` | boolean | optional |  |
| `orgUnitPath` | string | optional |  |

## `reports_activities_list`

Class: read

List Admin Activity audit log entries. Filter by application (login, drive, gmail, admin, token, etc.), user, date range, event. The single most useful admin endpoint for SMB visibility.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (must be a Workspace admin); "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `applicationName` | enum | required | Which application's activity to query |
| `userKey` | string | optional | User profile ID, email, or "all" (default) |
| `startTime` | string | optional | RFC 3339 lower bound. Gmail needs it, with at most 30 days to endTime. |
| `endTime` | string | optional | RFC 3339 upper bound (defaults to now when only startTime is given) |
| `eventName` | string | optional | Specific event name to filter |
| `actorIpAddress` | string | optional |  |
| `filters` | string | optional | Comma-separated event-parameter filters with relational operators |
| `orgUnitID` | string | optional |  |
| `groupIdFilter` | string | optional |  |
| `customerId` | string | optional |  |
| `maxResults` | number | optional |  |
| `pageToken` | string | optional |  |
